links.outcome: BVE versus ABI diagnostic performance for PAD against duplex reference standard
links.effect: Combined 751 limbs: BVE sensitivity 82.5%, specificity 93.9%, accuracy 91.2%, κ=0.76 versus ABI sensitivity 58.3%, specificity 87.4%, accuracy 80.6%, κ=0.46.
links.quote: In contrast, ABI sensitivity was 58.3%, specificity was 87.4%, accuracy was 80.6%, and κ=0.46.

links.outcome: AI performance across subgroups with comorbidities (diabetes, hypertension, tobacco, obesity) versus ABI
links.effect: BVE outperformed ABI in accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and κ in all analysed comorbidity subgroups; data from two studies combined.
links.quote: Increased accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and κ constant were present in all analysed subgroups when comparing BVE to ABI.

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic performance (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy) of an AI-driven Doppler diagnostic tool (BlueDop Vascular Expert) compared to ABI against duplex ultrasound, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
